main:1.text: Chapter 1: Fall of a Hero is the first chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth, taking place in Nibelheim. The chapter comprises Cloud Strife's retelling of events in Nibelheim during the Nibelheim Incident, as Cloud describes Sephiroth's fall from grace. Cloud recalls the time he and Sephiroth, as SOLDIER First Class, were sent to Nibelheim and guided by Tifa Lockhart to the local mako reactor.

main:2.text: Chapter 2: A New Journey Begins is the second chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth, taking place in Kalm and the Grasslands. It is the game's equivalent of the first part of Going After Sephiroth from the original game. Cloud Strife wakes up at the inn in Kalm and learns his friends have already departed and are exploring the town.

main:3.text: Chapter 3: Deeper into Darkness is the third chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. Cloud Strife's party ventures into the mythril mines in their quest to follow robed men to track down Sephiroth. It is the game's equivalent of the second part of Going After Sephiroth from the original game.

main:4.page: Dawn of a New Era (VII Rebirth)
main:4.text: Chapter 4: Dawn of a New Era is the fourth chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. Cloud Strife's party ventures into Junon. It is the game's equivalent of The Stowaway Strategy from the original game. Cloud Strife and his party made it through the Mythril Mines to Junon Region on their trail of robed men who appear to be headed to Junon and seeking to cross the sea.

main:5.text: Chapter 5: Blood in the Water is the fifth chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. It comprises Cloud and the party in the Shinra-8 ferry. The first half of the chapter involves a Queen's Blood tournament held on the ship, and the second half is set at night when Sephiroth infiltrates the ship. It is the game's equivalent of Dangerous Voyage from the original game.

main:6.text: Chapter 6: Fool's Paradise is the sixth chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. It comprises Cloud and the party's visit to Costa del Sol.

main:7.text: Chapter 7: Those Left Behind is the seventh chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. It comprises Cloud and the party's visit to Mt Corel and North Corel. Seeing that Yuffie is introduced to the party at this point, the chapter has heavy emphasis on her, including a section with her as the party leader, with the unique ability to throw her weapon outside of battles, mainly to destroy boxes and activate switches,…

main:8.text: Chapter 8: All That Glitters is the eighth chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. It comprises Cloud and the party's visit to The Gold Saucer and then Corel Prison (now known as The Dustbowl). It is the game's equivalent of both Sanctuary of Amusement and The Desert Prison from the original game.

main:9.text: Chapter 9: The Planet Stirs is the ninth chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. It comprises Cloud and the party's visit to Gongaga and the ruined reactor. It is the game's equivalent of Gongaga, the Village of Sadness from the original game. Gongaga was an optional area in the original, but is now required in Rebirth.

main:10.text: Chapter 10: Watcher of the Vale is the tenth chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. It comprises Cloud and the party's visit to Cosmo Canyon, the Sanctum of Planetology. It is the game's equivalent of In the Land of the Study of Planet Life from the original game.

main:11.text: Chapter 11: The Long Shadow of Shinra is the eleventh chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. Cloud and the others return to Nibelheim to access the terminal. It is the game's equivalent of Unnatural Hometown from the original game.

main:12.text: Chapter 12: A Golden Key is the twelfth chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. The gang returns to the Gold Saucer to find the keystone to the Temple of the Ancients. Affection mechanics determine who will be Cloud Strife's date for the night, and a mandatory party member for a coliseum tournament.

main:13.text: Chapter 13: Where Angels Fear to Tread is the thirteenth and penultimate chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. Cloud Strife and the others venture into The Temple of the Ancients to find the Black Materia. Parking the Tiny Bronco outside the temple marks the game's point of no return. It is the game's equivalent of Within the Temple of the Ancients from the original game.

main:14.text: Chapter 14: End of the World is the fourteenth and final chapter in Final Fantasy VII Rebirth. Cloud Strife and the others must find Aerith into The Forgotten Capital. It is the game's equivalent of Parting with Aeris from the original game.
